label: Local motion mockup — deterministic still-image animation, not AI video or gameplay recording
actual_instructions: Hold the entire polished image until 2.5s. Keep the board, colors, rules, three fish and Download UI fixed.
Animate the existing hand with two distinct taps at 4.05s and 4.35s on the singleton purple r1c6.
At 4.42s reveal exactly one cat, reused from the existing HUD artwork, centered in r1c6. Change only 0 to 1 in 0/8.
Confine two input rings, warm glow and three tiny paw sparkles to the first placement. Let the same hand rest below/right after the reveal.
Briefly glint existing rule-card edges at 6s, 7.5s and 9s; preserve their text. End with one cat, 1/8 and three fish.
Locked camera, no extra cats, crosses, moves, life loss, reward or victory. Reconstruct only the background obscured by the existing hand from nearby same-colored tiles.
Use original synthesized taps, pop, mew-like tone, chime and quiet sparse plucked notes. Installed macOS voices returned empty files, so the rendered clip has no narration.
limitations: This is a deterministic presentation over a still image, not playable Unity or captured game behavior.
A small area originally obscured by the hand is reconstructed; the new counter digit uses a local font.
The cat is existing illustration composited into the cell; no model-generated animation or new raster artwork was used.
planned_voiceover: Double-tap to place a cat. One per row, column, and color. Keep cats apart.
voiceover_limitation: Installed macOS voices returned empty audio; parent approved SFX and music only.
